```yaml
name: Test BPFtrace Rust Uprobe Tutorial

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]

jobs:
  test-rust-uprobe:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Install Rust toolchain
      uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
      with:
        toolchain: stable
        override: true

    - name: Test helloworld project
      run: |
        cd src/12-profile
        cargo build --verbose --target-dir target-debug
        # Verify hello function symbol exists in debug build
        nm target-debug/debug/helloworld | grep hello || { echo "Error: hello function symbol not found"; exit 1; }
        # Test binary execution
        ./target-debug/debug/helloworld || true

    - name: Test args project
      run: |
        cd src/12-profile
        cargo build --verbose --target-dir target-debug --features args
        # Verify hello function symbol exists in debug build
        nm target-debug/debug/args | grep hello || { echo "Error: hello function symbol not found"; exit 1; }
        # Test binary execution
        ./target-debug/debug/args || true

    - name: Test bpftrace attach with wildcard pattern
      run: |
        cd src/12-profile
        # Build binaries
        cargo build --verbose --target-dir target-debug
        cargo build --verbose --target-dir target-debug --features args
        
        # Test bpftrace can attach to helloworld binary with wildcard pattern
        timeout 5s bpftrace -e 'uprobe:target-debug/debug/helloworld:_ZN10helloworld5helloE { printf("Hello called\n"); }' &
        sleep 2
        ./target-debug/debug/helloworld
        sleep 1
        kill %1 2>/dev/null || true
        
        # Test bpftrace can attach to args binary with wildcard pattern
        timeout 5s bpftrace -e 'uprobe:target-debug/debug/args:_ZN10helloworld5helloE { printf("Args hello called\n"); }' &
        sleep 2
        ./target-debug/debug/args
        sleep 1
        kill %1 2>/dev/null || true

    - name: Verify wildcard pattern functionality
      run: |
        cd src/12-profile
        # Show that wildcard pattern matches mangled symbols
        echo "Testing wildcard pattern matching..."
        nm target-debug/debug/helloworld | grep "_ZN10helloworld5hello" | head -1
        echo "Wildcard pattern _ZN10helloworld5hello* should match above symbol"
```
